name: South Mist Storage Link Phase III
researcher_notes: Source is the EIA natural gas pipeline projects release for August 2026, Historical Projects sheet, Excel row 136. It lists South Mist Storage Link Phase III, owner Northwest Natural Gas Co, type lateral, status completed, in service November 1999, Oregon, cost 35 million dollars, 29 miles, 190 million cubic feet per day, 24 inch, intrastate, state regulated. Sister rows on the same sheet are Phase IV (row 319, 11.7 mi, 2003) and Phase V (row 343, 50 mi, 2004); these are separate candidates. The existing North Mist Expansion Pipeline (P2573, 13 mi) is a different project (EIA row 957, 2019). Not in the roster under another name. Meets the sponsor, location and completed-build tests and exceeds the 25 km length rule (29 mi). Only one origin was found, so tier is medium and no second source is claimed. Intrastate line, so no FERC filing is expected; the Oregon Public Utility Commission was not checked. Start and end points are not stated beyond Oregon; the line links NW Natural's Mist storage field area to its Portland-area system, which is not sourced here and was left blank. Capacity read from the EIA column order, matching the 120 value shown for North Mist. No route found. Owner name kept as the source spells it; no close match exists in the owner list.
